sentences.en: I don't know when I'll get around to visiting you.
sentences.zh: 我不知道什么时候才有机会去拜访你。

sentences.en: I never go to London without visiting the British Museum.
sentences.zh: 每次我去伦敦都会参观大英博物馆。

sentences.en: I never go to Kyoto without visiting the Nanzenji Temple.
sentences.zh: 每次我去京都都会参拜南禅寺。
